clinician.final_diagnosis: Hydatid cyst (HC) in the right hemithorax
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 29-year-old female presented with intermittent respiratory symptoms including cough and sputum persisting for two years after COVID-19 infection. Due to persistent symptoms, an FNAC was performed on a right hemithorax lesion, which suggested the presence of a hydatid cyst. Subsequently, the patient underwent thoracotomy with abscess removal. Histopathological examination of the resected abscess confirmed the diagnosis of hydatid cyst. The postoperative period was uneventful and the patient's symptoms improved.
